findings.title: Fixture-scope tests break after the authorized fixture repair
findings.description: BEFORE reads the current worktree fixture rather than immutable protected-base bytes. After KL-024 applies the exact authorized September 27 to September 28 change, BEFORE.count(OLD) becomes zero, test_only_proposed_literal_change_is_authorized fails, and other content-scope cases receive the unexpected-baseline error. Thus the governance regression suite fails on the intended future repaired fixture even though the task guard correctly approves that repair against its protected base. Bind test input to the immutable pre-repair Git revision and verify the suite with the approved repair present, without weakening any oracle or scope checks.
